description_en: Queries the details of speech corpora in a speech push task, including the broadcast voice, corpus type, and corpus text
description_zh: 查询语料推送任务下的语料详情，包括语料的播报声音、语料类型和语料文本等
name: QuerySpeechPushJobSpeech

parameters.help_en: The ID of the push task. The **Data** field returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html is the push task ID
parameters.help_zh: 推送任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html成功后返回的**Data**字段为推送任务ID
parameters.name: job_code

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view your instance ID.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
></notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
